implementation.name: Jaguar (MiSTer)
implementation.notes: Source availability (T5.4): open -- the repository carries 128 HDL source files (15 systemverilog, 112 verilog, 1 vhdl) alongside 1 prebuilt .rbf binaries. There is no open_source column in the delivered schema (data-model.md §1.9 deleted the proposed core table together with its flags); the presence of hdl_language_id and of implementation_path rows is how that fact is stated here. Machine mapping: hand-mapped, not MRA-setname-derived -- a console core ships no MRA files. The core reimplements the Atari Jaguar, giving machine_id jaguar. Every id was checked against extract/machine.json. License: https://github.com/MiSTer-devel/Jaguar_MiSTer/blob/master/LICENSE is the verbatim GNU GPL version 2 text, and the grant in https://github.com/MiSTer-devel/Jaguar_MiSTer/blob/master/Jaguar.sv reads "either version 2 of the License, or (at your option) any later version" -- hence GPL-2.0-or-later. hdl_language_id: no single HDL family reaches 90% of the 128 source files (15 systemverilog, 112 verilog, 1 vhdl), excluding the shared framework directory. accuracy_id omitted: the repository makes no timing-fidelity claim this build could verify.
